title: dect_nr: Update to V1.6.1 (2025-07)
description:
Use "field" instead of "flag" suffix for fields indicating that a later
field is present. This will align with the terminology used in the spec.

Put subsequent PHY layer capabilities in a subtree.
Use wmem_strbuf for additional info strings.
